about: UiPath, Inc. provides an automation platform that offers a range of robotic process automation (RPA) solutions primarily in the United States, Romania, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and internationally. It offers the UiPath platform, an integrated enterprise software platform that enables AI agents, robots, people, and models to work together in coordinated workflows.
